title: Season 1 companion: the full-length roles & responsibilities video
oneliner: Season 1's capstone is a full-length YouTube video on the AI infrastructure architect's roles and responsibilities - with a surprise at the end.
says: With Season 1 complete, he has made a full-length video on the roles and responsibilities of the AI infrastructure solution architect and posted it on his YouTube channel. He points viewers to the link and mentions a surprise at the end - a detail that will help your AI infrastructure architect journey.
explained: The reels are the syllabus and this video is the lecture (the reels list the topics; the video is the full lesson). If Season 1's ten episodes gave you the focus areas - GPUs, gateways, scaling, private hosting, edge, caching, DR - the long video is where he ties them into an actual job description: what the role owns day to day, end to end.
Find it on his YouTube channel (@ArchitectITCloud). Watch it after the ten episodes, not instead of them - the reels give you the vocabulary that makes the long version land faster.
takeaway: Pointer reel: the Season 1 deep-dive lives on his YouTube channel - watch it as the season's capstone.
